thread:
Nikhil Rao: quick sync  we're cutting over a trimmed runtime image tomorrow 07:45 PT. need final RBAC delta + KMS signing window.
Samira Gupta: okay. paste the RBAC diff here so i can verify least-priv. remember to annotate the patch for audit.
Nikhil Rao: patch is simple  replace cluster-binding with namespace RoleBinding for `ci-image-baker` in infra-builds. snippet below.
```
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: ci-baker-binding
  namespace: infra-builds
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: ci-image-baker
  namespace: infra-builds
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: image-baker-limited
```
Elena Ruiz: KMS policy: signer key must allow AsymmetricSign for `ci-baker@infra.iam`, deny decrypt/encrypt. i added a condition constraining signing to artifact names `trim-*`.
Owen Park: minor vuln triage note  stripped lib symlink causes an old probe to fail healthcheck. non-exploitable but breaks ops monitoring. recommend adding a small shim and a canary test.
Samira Gupta: add `security.ticket=SEC-1301` and `operator=nikhil` annotations on the k8s patch. also ensure CI uses `X-Audit-Id: gate-3601234567` header on KMS calls so we can correlate logs.
sign-bot: preflight checklist: [RBAC annotated], [KMS policy reviewed], [X-Audit-Id present], [seccomp profile uploaded], [canary reserved].
Nikhil Rao: canary config: `privileged:false`, seccomp profile `trim-min.json`, drop ALL caps, runAsNonRoot true. if canary fails for compatibility we'll patch and delay; if we see syscall regression we revoke signing and rollback.
Elena Ruiz: i'll vet the key policy and post the exact IAM condition link.
Owen Park: i'll run seccomp fuzz + eBPF syscall trace and post a short excerpt here by EOD.
Samira Gupta: once traces are up i'll do a final audit-scan. if green we proceed with the 07:45 gate.
Nikhil Rao: thanks everyone  i'll post the gate ticket and ping 15m before. :thumbsup:
